title: Number 5 — Five Loaves of Bread
memory_verse: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two fish." — John 6:9 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn the number 5 and hear the story of Jesus feeding over 5,000 people with just five loaves of bread and two fish.
content: Today we are learning about the number 5! Hold up five fingers — that's your whole hand! Count them — one, two, three, four, five!
One day, a huge crowd of people came to hear Jesus teach. They were all very hungry, but there was no food! A little boy came forward with his lunch — just FIVE small loaves of bread and two fish.

Jesus took the boy's small lunch, thanked God for it, and then something amazing happened — the food kept multiplying! Jesus fed over 5,000 people with just five loaves and two fish! Nothing is too small for God to use. He can do amazing things!
activity: Use play dough or paper to make five loaves of bread and two fish. Practice writing the number 5. Count five items in your lunch or snack.
discussion: How many loaves of bread did the little boy have?
Can you hold up five fingers?
What amazing thing did Jesus do with the boy's lunch?
